rationale: The short is already at a small loss and the price is now above both the 9‑EMA and VWAP, indicating a shift toward bullish bias. With the stop only ~0.6% above the current price versus a ~0.8% distance to the profit target, the odds of a further rise and hitting the stop appear higher than a mean‑reversion move to the target. Closing now limits loss and preserves the remaining daily loss budget.
